abstract: A case was reported concerning a successful removal of tumor thrombus extending into the right atrium through the left brachiocephalic vein and the superior vena cava. The patient was a 34-year-old man who underwent a left inguinal orchiectomy for immature teratoma of testis in June 1987. The operation was followed by another three operations for excision of lymph node metastases and five courses of cisplatin based combination chemotherapy. In December 1988, the chest CT scan film revealed filling defect in the superior vena cava and the right atrium. Thrombus was detected using echocardiography and angiography. He had no symptom, but multiple pulmonary infarcts were also detected. In February 1989, the operation was performed by means of cardio-pulmonary bypass. A soft yellowish thrombus attached to the left venous angle was removed with resection of the left brachiocephalic vein. Microscopic findings revealed that the thrombus was metastatic testicular teratoma. With further treatment after the operation, he has been disease-free for 14 months now. We conclude that in this case aggressive surgical management following chemotherapy had great value to control the disseminated testicular tumor.
abstract_ja: 精巣の未熟奇形腫に対して1987年6月に左鼠径部精巣摘除術を施行された34歳男性において、左腕頭静脈および上大静脈を経て右心房へ進展した腫瘍栓の摘出に成功した症例を報告する。手術後に3回の手術によるリンパ節転移の切除と、5コースのシスプラチン併用化学療法が行われた。1988年12月の胸部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で上大静脈および右心房に陰影欠損を認め、心エコーおよび血管造影で腫瘍栓を確認した。自覚症状はなかったが、多発性肺梗塞も認められた。1989年2月に人工心肺下で手術が行われ、左静脈角に付着した軟らかい黄色の腫瘍栓を左腕頭静脈切除とともに摘出した。組織学的検査で、腫瘍栓は転移性精巣奇形腫と判明した。術後の追加治療を経て、14か月間無病で経過している。化学療法後の積極的な外科的管理は、播種性精巣腫瘍の制御に大きな価値があったと結論づける。
